title: Run Fable 5 like a team lead, not a chatbot
description:
Everyone's using Fable 5 like a chatbot. The top 1% run it like a team lead. One model plans, cheaper models do the labor, the smart one reviews, and the AI bill goes down not up. Fable leaves the Claude subscription July 7 then goes paid. Comment FABLE for the full playbook.
